title: Protocol for combining immunological procedures with cell cycle stage synchronization to detect cell-cycle-specific complexes
protocol: Seed HeLa cells at 2 × 10^6 cells / 10 cm dish for each time point.
Allow the cells to grow for 16 h from the seeded time point and replace the media with supplemented DMEM media containing thymidine.
Wash the cells twice with 10 mL of drug-free supplemented DMEM media prewarmed at 37°C.
Culture the cells in drug-free supplemented DMEM media for 10 h.
Replace the media with supplemented DMEM media containing thymidine and allow the cells to grow under the thymidine-containing media for 16 h.
Seed HeLa cells at 2 × 10^6 cells per 10 cm dish for each time point.
Allow the cells to grow for 16 hours from the seeded time point.
Replace the media with supplemented DMEM media containing thymidine.
Wash the drug-treated cells twice with 10 mL of drug-free supplemented DMEM media prewarmed at 37°C.
Culture the cells in drug-free supplemented DMEM media for 6 hours.
Replace the media with supplemented DMEM media containing nocodazole to block mitotic progression by depolymerizing microtubules.
Treat the cells with nocodazole for 6 hours.
Collect the cells arrested in mitosis at time zero.
Wash cells twice with 10 mL of drug-free supplemented DMEM media prewarmed at 37°C.
Culture cells in drug-free supplemented DMEM media.
Harvest cells at selected time points (e.g., 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 minutes).
Remove the media by decantation.
Dislodge the cells directly by scraping and transfer them into 1.5 mL tubes with approximately 1 mL of media.
Spin down the cells at 80 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the cells twice with 500 μL of PBS.
Add 500 μL of ice-cold NP-40 lysis buffer per 2 × 10 cm dishes and suspend the cells by pipetting ten times.
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes.
Mix the suspension with a Vortex mixer for 15 seconds at full speed to disrupt viscous materials.
Alternatively, carry out benzonase treatment, sonication, or homogenization on the lysates to break DNA.
Centrifuge the cell extracts at 10,000 × g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to clean tubes.
Measure the protein concentration of the supernatant using a standard Bradford protein assay.
Layer 800 μl of the highest glycerol concentration in NP-40 lysis buffer at the bottom of a 5 mL tube.
Gently overlay 800 μl of each subsequent glycerol concentration in NP-40 lysis buffer stepwise on the previous layer.
Allow the gradient to stand for 1 hour at 4°C.
Position the micropipette tip vertically near the liquid surface in the center of the tube.
Maintain immersion depth and aspirate the sample carefully from top to bottom.
Make glycerol gradient.
Choose rotor and tube type depending on volume of cell lysate.
Fill 9/10 volume of tube size with sample plus glycerol cushion.
Layer 800 μL highest glycerol concentration in NP-40 lysis buffer at the bottom of a tube.
Overlay 800 μL each glycerol concentration in NP-40 lysis buffer softly and gently on previous layer.
Keep the tube for 1 hour at 4°C.
Centrifuge and fractionate.
Layer 0.5–2 mg of cell extracts on the glycerol cushion (maximum volume of 500 μL).
Ultracentrifuge at 30,000 × g for 18 hours at 4°C.
Set the acceleration and deceleration to a minimum during centrifugation.
Fractionate the gradient from top to bottom using a micropipette with surface tension.
Each fraction volume is 200 μL.
Add an equal amount of ice-cold TCA solution to 20 μL of each fraction to precipitate proteins.
Mix the mixture thoroughly for 15 seconds at full speed using a Vortex mixer.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the mixture for 10 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant from each fraction.
Rinse the pellet fraction with ice-cold ethanol.
Centrifuge the rinsed fractions for 5 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4°C.
Dry the pellet.
Resuspend the dried pellet into 50 μL of 1 × SDS sample buffer.
Subject 1/10 volume of each sample to SDS-PAGE and western blotting analysis.
Add 0.5 μg of the antibody to the 180 μL of each fraction and an equal amount of ice-cold NP-40 lysis buffer.
Rotate the tubes gently at 4°C overnight.
Add 40 μl of protein G-Sepharose beads (50% suspension) to each tube and rotate each tube gently at 4°C for 6 h.
Wash protein G-Sepharose bead once with 500 μl of NP-40 lysis buffer.
Wash protein G-Sepharose bead twice with 500 μl of NP-40 lysis buffer without NaCl.
Remove the wash buffer completely and add 40 μl of 2 × SDS sample buffer into each tube.
Mix by gentle Vortex mixing and boil at 95°C for 6 min.
Mix boiled samples with high-speed Vortex mixing for 15 seconds.
Spin down the mixed samples immediately.
Subject immunoprecipitants to SDS-PAGE and western blotting analysis.
Store samples at -20°C after step 9g for several months if needed.
Prepare poly-lysine coated coverslips by coating acid-washed coverslips in bulk with 1 mg/mL PLL in ddH2O in a petri dish.
Rock the coated coverslips for at least 30 minutes at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Wash coverslips extensively with ddH2O at least 10 times.
Rinse coverslips twice in 100% ethanol under sterile conditions.
Store washed coverslips in 70% ethanol for several months.
Place poly-L-lysine coated coverslips in 10 cm dishes after ethanol sterilization.
Seed HeLa cells at 2 × 10^6 cells per 10 cm dish per time point.
Grow the seeded cells for 16 hours and replace media with supplemented DMEM containing thymidine.
Treat the cells with thymidine for 16 hours.
Wash the drug-treated cells twice with 10 mL of drug-free supplemented DMEM media prewarmed at 37°C.
Culture the cells in drug-free supplemented DMEM media for 10 hours.
Replace the media with supplemented DMEM media containing thymidine after 10 hours.
Treat the cells with thymidine for another 16 hours.
Wash the drug-treated cells twice with 10 mL of drug-free supplemented DMEM media prewarmed at 37°C.
Culture the cells under drug-free supplemented DMEM media.
Collect the cells on coverslips in 6-well plates 6 hours after thymidine release.
Observe cells in G2 and mitosis around 8 hours from thymidine release.
Collect samples every 20 minutes after 8 hours for cells progressing through mitosis.
Wash the samples with PHEM buffer twice.
Permeabilize the cells with PHEM containing 0.2% Triton X-100 for 2 minutes on ice.
Fix the cells with 4% paraformaldehyde in PHEM for 20 minutes on ice.
Wash the cells twice with ice-cold PBS for 5 minutes on ice.
Perform the blocking step with boiled donkey serum.
Incubate each sample with first antibodies (anti-Mad2, Dynein Antibody, 74 kDa Intermediate chains, cytoplasmic, clone 74.1, 70.1, and Anti-β-Tubulin-Cy3 antibodies) at 4°C overnight.
Wash samples three times with TBST buffer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate each sample with second antibody (anti-mouse or rabbit IgG (H+L) conjugated Alexa Fluor 488) at 4°C for 6 hours.
Wash samples three times with TBST buffer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Stain the cells with 50 ng/mL Hoechst 33342 solution for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Mount the samples with SlowFade Gold Antifade Mountant.
Observe the samples under fluorescence microscopy.
